Explore funding overlaps

Beneficiary lists and aid registers may contain the same recipient. Compare names across both datasets and inspect overlaps. A match alone does not establish unlawful double funding.

Inputs
COMPANY OR BENEFICIARY NAME *
MINIMUM SIMILARITY BETWEEN NAMES (0–100) *
70 – Broad
80 – Expanded
85 – Default
90 – Strict
95 – Very strict
100 – Maximum name similarity

85 is the starting value: Names from the two registers are associated when they reach at least 85 out of 100 similarity points.

70–80: more possible associations, allowing greater spelling differences. 90–100: stricter matching. Legal forms, capitalisation and word order may differ even at 100.

Select a value and run the search again. Records without an associated match remain visible separately. The score is not the probability that the companies are identical.
